svg.title: RC low-pass frequency response
svg.desc: Magnitude and phase for 1 kilohm and 1 microfarad from 10 Hz to 100 kHz. Circles from the AC sweep follow the analytic curves. At the cutoff near 159 Hz the magnitude is about minus 3 dB and the phase is minus 45 degrees.
